response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(laps, '') AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM per_driver;

assumptions.assumption: Missing laps values are NULL or empty strings; NULLIF maps empty strings to NULL, and AVG skips NULLs.

Drivers are grouped by driverId across all seasons and races, with no year restriction. A driver with no non-missing laps values is left out of the average of average laps but still counts toward the average points total.
A grid value of 12 or higher means grid >= 12. Rows with a NULL grid are excluded, and pit-lane starts (grid 0) are below the threshold.
